description: The Science Data Bank deposit assembles environmental and socioeconomic variables for the Pinglu Canal region of Guangxi, China, over 2000–2023. Guilin University of Electronic Technology and the Aerospace Information Research Institute describe 23 parameter sets. They include surface-water types, precipitation, land cover, wetlands, elevation, vegetation, air pollutants, population, gross domestic product, residential buildings, impermeable surfaces, rail lines and roads. The repository says the prepared outputs are stored in Shapefile form and lists CC BY 4.0 with public access. A modeller could use the layers to build a corridor baseline or supply exposure inputs to a canal-region land and water simulation. The deposit mixes source observations and analysed change products, so variable-specific dates and resolutions must be checked before joining layers. It does not give vessel demand or canal operating rules. The data files, projection details and 23 layer definitions were not downloaded or checked. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Spatial and temporal variation characteristic datacube of the Pinglu Canal region from 2000 to 2023
